newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - OLYMPICS:SOCOG PRESIDENT ILIFFE QUITS.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - OLYMPICS:SOCOG PRESIDENT ILIFFE QUITS.

text.p: President of the Sydney Organising Committee for the Olympic Games (SOCOG) John Iliffe on Friday said he would resign.
Iliffe said in a statement that the Sydney 2000 Games would demand too much of his time.
Iliffe was appointed Sydney 2000 Olympics boss in March.
Iliffe, chairman of Australian retailer Woolworths Ltd, insurance firm GIO Australia and electronics company AWA Ltd, replaced Gary Pemberton, chairman of national airline Qantas Airways Ltd.
Pemberton cited business and personal reasons for standing down, but Iliffe, 59, told reporters at the time that he would not relinquish his current business roles.
Iliffe had just returned from observing the Atlanta Games.
